func TestRunExecutesFixedLaunchWithLinkedDependencies(t *testing.T) {
	path := writeLaunch(t, validLaunch())
	client := &testClient{}
	dependencies := Dependencies{
		DriverFactory:   testDriverFactory{},
		ClientFactory:   testClientFactory{client: client},
		MCPMaterializer: testMaterializer{},
		Config:          testConfig(),
	}
	if err := run(context.Background(), func(string) string { return path }, func() (Dependencies, error) { return dependencies, nil }); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("run() error = %v", err)
	}
	if client.appendAttempts != 2 || !client.completed {
		t.Fatalf("append attempts=%d completed=%t", client.appendAttempts, client.completed)
	}
}

func TestRunFailsWithoutLinkedDependencies(t *testing.T) {
	if err := run(context.Background(), func(string) string { return "/launch.json" }, nil); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "not linked") {
		t.Fatalf("run() error = %v", err)
	}
}

func TestRunReportsInputAndDependencyFailures(t *testing.T) {
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name    string
		lookup  func(string) string
		factory func() (Dependencies, error)
		want    string
	}{
		{name: "missing path", lookup: func(string) string { return "" }, factory: func() (Dependencies, error) { return Dependencies{}, nil }, want: launchFileEnvironment},
		{name: "dependency factory", lookup: func(string) string { return "/launch.json" }, factory: func() (Dependencies, error) { return Dependencies{}, errors.New("unavailable") }, want: "construct in-image"},
		{name: "open input", lookup: func(string) string { return "/does-not-exist" }, factory: func() (Dependencies, error) {
			return Dependencies{DriverFactory: testDriverFactory{}, ClientFactory: testClientFactory{client: &testClient{}}, MCPMaterializer: testMaterializer{}, Config: testConfig()}, nil
		}, want: "open mounted launch input"},
		{name: "invalid config", lookup: func(string) string { return writeLaunch(t, validLaunch()) }, factory: func() (Dependencies, error) {
			return Dependencies{DriverFactory: testDriverFactory{}, ClientFactory: testClientFactory{client: &testClient{}}, MCPMaterializer: testMaterializer{}}, nil
		}, want: "maximum batch"},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			err := run(context.Background(), testCase.lookup, testCase.factory)
			if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), testCase.want) {
				t.Fatalf("run() error = %v; want %q", err, testCase.want)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestRegisterDependenciesAndMain(t *testing.T) {
	previous := linkedDependencies
	linkedDependencies = nil
	defer func() { linkedDependencies = previous }()

	assertPanics(t, func() { RegisterDependencies(nil) })
	dependencies := Dependencies{DriverFactory: testDriverFactory{}, ClientFactory: testClientFactory{client: &testClient{}}, MCPMaterializer: testMaterializer{}, Config: testConfig()}
	RegisterDependencies(func() (Dependencies, error) { return dependencies, nil })
	assertPanics(t, func() { RegisterDependencies(func() (Dependencies, error) { return dependencies, nil }) })

	t.Setenv(launchFileEnvironment, writeLaunch(t, validLaunch()))
	main()
}

func TestDecodeLaunchRejectsInvalidAndTrailingInput(t *testing.T) {
	for _, input := range []string{"not json", `{}` + `{}`, `{"unknown":true}`} {
		if _, err := decodeLaunch(strings.NewReader(input)); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("decodeLaunch(%q) succeeded", input)
		}
	}
	if _, err := decodeLaunch(strings.NewReader(`{}`)); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "invalid mounted launch input") {
		t.Fatalf("decodeLaunch(empty launch) error = %v", err)
	}
}

func assertPanics(t *testing.T, call func()) {
	t.Helper()
	defer func() {
		if recover() == nil {
			t.Fatal("call did not panic")
		}
	}()
	call()
}

// TestBuiltEntrypointRunsConcreteDeliveryPath builds the exact untagged
// agentrun-job binary and runs one full AgentRun delivery against a fixture
// vendor process and a run-scoped Platform Core fixture: the concrete
// stream-json driver is invoked exactly once, the normalized SDK envelopes are
// uploaded unchanged and acknowledged by the server, and the terminal result
// is completed only after that acknowledgement.
func TestBuiltEntrypointRunsConcreteDeliveryPath(t *testing.T) {
	binary := buildCommand(t)
	server := newFixturePlatformServer(t)
	injectionDirectory := t.TempDir()
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(injectionDirectory, "mcp-1.json"), []byte(`{"server_id":"mcp-1"}`), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	credentialPath := writeCredential(t, "fixture-token")
	marker := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "marker")
	t.Setenv("AGENTRUN_FIXTURE_MARKER", marker)

	launch := validLaunch()
	launch.MCPServers = []contractsagentrun.MCPServerLaunch{{
		ServerID: "mcp-1", Transport: contractsagentrun.MCPStdioTransport, ConfigurationDigest: "mcp-digest",
		Stdio: &contractsagentrun.MCPStdioLaunch{Command: "mcp", WorkingDirectory: "/workspace", CredentialBindings: []contractsagentrun.CredentialInjectionBinding{{CredentialBindingID: "credential-1", Target: "API_TOKEN", Purpose: contractsagentrun.MCPStdioEnvironmentCredentialPurpose}}},
	}}
	launchPath := writeLaunch(t, launch)

	command := exec.Command(binary)
	command.Env = append(os.Environ(),
		launchFileEnvironment+"="+launchPath,
		platformEndpointEnvironment+"="+server.URL(),
		runCredentialEnvironment+"="+credentialPath,
		mcpInjectionDirectoryEnvironment+"="+injectionDirectory,
		"AGENTRUN_FIXTURE_MARKER="+marker,
	)
	if output, err := command.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("built command error = %v\n%s", err, output)
	}

	received := server.events()
	if len(received) < 3 {
		t.Fatalf("server received %d events; want started, message, terminal", len(received))
	}
	if received[0]["event_type"] != "started" || received[0]["sequence"] != float64(1) {
		t.Fatalf("first event = %#v", received[0])
	}
	last := received[len(received)-1]
	if last["event_type"] != "terminal" {
		t.Fatalf("last event = %#v", last)
	}
	var streamID string
	for _, event := range received {
		if event["stream_id"] != nil {
			streamID, _ = event["stream_id"].(string)
		}
		if event["stream_id"] != streamID {
			t.Fatalf("event stream drifted: %#v vs %q", event, streamID)
		}
	}
	if !server.completed {
		t.Fatal("Platform Core fixture did not receive the completion")
	}
	if server.completionResult["outcome"] != "succeeded" {
		t.Fatalf("completion result = %#v", server.completionResult)
	}
	contents, err := os.ReadFile(marker)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(string(contents)) != filepath.Join(injectionDirectory, "mcp-1.json") {
		t.Fatalf("vendor marker = %q", contents)
	}
	if server.agentRunID != "run-1" || server.authorization != "Bearer fixture-token" {
		t.Fatalf("run scope = %q auth = %q", server.agentRunID, server.authorization)
	}
}

// TestBuiltEntrypointCancelsVendorOnPersistentAppendFailure proves that when
// event delivery retries are exhausted, the Job cancels the still-running
// vendor session, observes its terminal state, reaps the child, and fails
// without reporting a completion to Platform Core.
func TestBuiltEntrypointCancelsVendorOnPersistentAppendFailure(t *testing.T) {
	binary := buildCommand(t)
	t.Setenv("AGENTRUN_FIXTURE_MODE", "slow")

	failing := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
	}))
	defer failing.Close()

	injectionDirectory := t.TempDir()
	pidFile := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "vendor.pid")
	t.Setenv("AGENTRUN_FIXTURE_PID_FILE", pidFile)
	credentialPath := writeCredential(t, "fixture-token")
	launchPath := writeLaunch(t, validLaunch())

	command := exec.Command(binary)
	command.Env = append(os.Environ(),
		launchFileEnvironment+"="+launchPath,
		platformEndpointEnvironment+"="+failing.URL,
		runCredentialEnvironment+"="+credentialPath,
		mcpInjectionDirectoryEnvironment+"="+injectionDirectory,
		"AGENTRUN_FIXTURE_PID_FILE="+pidFile,
	)
	output, err, jobIdentity, identityErr := runCommandWithIdentity(command)
	if identityErr != nil {
		t.Fatal(identityErr)
	}
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("built command unexpectedly succeeded with persistent append failure\n%s", output)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(string(output), "append AgentRun events") {
		t.Fatalf("built command output does not report the delivery failure: %s", output)
	}
	pid, err := os.ReadFile(pidFile)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read vendor process identity: %v", err)
	}
	if err := assertProcessGone(t, strings.TrimSpace(string(pid)), jobIdentity); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestBuiltEntrypointWaitsForRuntimeWaitOnPersistentAppendFailure(t *testing.T) {
	binary := buildCommand(t)
	processEvidence := map[string]any{
		"schema":       "oac.agentrun-process-cancellation-observation/v1",
		"test":         "TestBuiltEntrypointWaitsForRuntimeWaitOnPersistentAppendFailure",
		"wait_owners":  []string{"agentrun-vendor owns the configured Runtime exec.Cmd.Wait", "agentrun-job childReaper owns the adapter exec.Cmd.Wait"},
		"observations": []map[string]any{},
	}
	processEvidencePath := filepath.Join("..", "..", "artifacts", "agentrun-cancellation-prerequisite", "built-production-chain-process.json")
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(processEvidencePath), 0o755); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			return
		}
		contents, err := json.MarshalIndent(processEvidence, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			return
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(processEvidencePath, contents, 0o600); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	t.Setenv("AGENTRUN_FIXTURE_MODE", "delayed-termination")
	pidFile := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "runtime.json")
	t.Setenv("AGENTRUN_FIXTURE_PID_FILE", pidFile)
	failing := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
	}))
	defer failing.Close()
	launchPath := writeLaunch(t, validLaunch())
	command := exec.Command(binary)
	command.Env = append(os.Environ(),
		launchFileEnvironment+"="+launchPath,
		platformEndpointEnvironment+"="+failing.URL,
		runCredentialEnvironment+"="+writeCredential(t, "fixture-token"),
		mcpInjectionDirectoryEnvironment+"="+t.TempDir(),
		"AGENTRUN_FIXTURE_PID_FILE="+pidFile,
	)
	var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
	command.Stdout, command.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
	if err := command.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	job, err := readProcessSnapshot("/proc", command.Process.Pid)
	if err != nil {
		_ = command.Process.Kill()
		_ = command.Wait()
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	finished := make(chan struct{})
	var runErr error
	go func() {
		runErr = command.Wait()
		close(finished)
	}()
	releasePath := pidFile + ".release"
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		_ = os.WriteFile(releasePath, []byte("release"), 0o600)
		if raw, readErr := os.ReadFile(pidFile); readErr == nil {
			if chain, parseErr := parseProcessIdentity(strings.TrimSpace(string(raw))); parseErr == nil {
				if child, same, observeErr := observeProcess("/proc", chain.Child); observeErr == nil && same && child.state != "Z" {
					process, _ := os.FindProcess(chain.Child.PID)
					if process != nil {
						_ = process.Kill()
					}
				}
			}
		}
		select {
		case <-finished:
		case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
			_ = command.Process.Kill()
			<-finished
		}
	})

	waitFile := func(path string) []byte {
		t.Helper()
		deadline := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second)
		for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
			contents, readErr := os.ReadFile(path)
			if readErr == nil {
				return contents
			}
			if !os.IsNotExist(readErr) {
				t.Fatal(readErr)
			}
			time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
		}
		select {
		case <-finished:
			t.Fatalf("fixture did not create %s; Job error=%v output=%s", filepath.Base(path), runErr, stdout.String()+stderr.String())
		default:
			t.Fatalf("fixture did not create %s before the Job completed", filepath.Base(path))
		}
		return nil
	}
	rawChain := strings.TrimSpace(string(waitFile(pidFile)))
	chain, err := parseProcessIdentity(rawChain)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	processEvidence["process_chain"] = chain
	if chain.Owner != job.processIdentity || chain.Child.ParentPID != chain.Parent.PID || chain.Parent.ParentPID != job.PID {
		t.Fatal("Runtime process chain does not match the built Job and linked adapter")
	}
	_ = waitFile(pidFile + ".term")
	child, same, err := observeProcess("/proc", chain.Child)
	if err != nil || !same || child.state == "Z" || child.ParentPID != chain.Parent.PID {
		t.Fatal("the same Runtime process was not live under its recorded adapter during cancellation")
	}
	adapter, sameAdapter, adapterErr := observeProcess("/proc", chain.Parent)
	jobAtTerm, sameJob, err := observeProcess("/proc", job.processIdentity)
	processEvidence["observations"] = append(processEvidence["observations"].([]map[string]any), map[string]any{
		"phase":        "after Runtime TERM and before release",
		"runtime":      map[string]any{"pid": child.PID, "start_ticks": child.StartTicks, "ppid": child.ParentPID, "state": child.state, "same_identity": same},
		"adapter":      map[string]any{"pid": adapter.PID, "start_ticks": adapter.StartTicks, "ppid": adapter.ParentPID, "state": adapter.state, "same_identity": sameAdapter, "probe_error": errText(adapterErr)},
		"job":          map[string]any{"pid": jobAtTerm.PID, "start_ticks": jobAtTerm.StartTicks, "ppid": jobAtTerm.ParentPID, "state": jobAtTerm.state, "same_identity": sameJob, "probe_error": errText(err)},
		"runtime_wait": "not returned; the same Runtime identity is live",
	})
	select {
	case <-finished:
		childAtReturn, sameChildAtReturn, childErr := observeProcess("/proc", chain.Child)
		adapterAtReturn, sameAdapterAtReturn, adapterErr := observeProcess("/proc", chain.Parent)
		jobAtReturn, sameJobAtReturn, jobErr := observeProcess("/proc", job.processIdentity)
		processEvidence["outcome"] = "Job returned before the Runtime owning Wait"
		processEvidence["observations"] = append(processEvidence["observations"].([]map[string]any), map[string]any{
			"phase":        "when Job returned before release",
			"runtime":      map[string]any{"pid": chain.Child.PID, "start_ticks": childAtReturn.StartTicks, "ppid": childAtReturn.ParentPID, "state": childAtReturn.state, "same_identity": sameChildAtReturn, "probe_error": errText(childErr)},
			"adapter":      map[string]any{"pid": chain.Parent.PID, "start_ticks": adapterAtReturn.StartTicks, "ppid": adapterAtReturn.ParentPID, "state": adapterAtReturn.state, "same_identity": sameAdapterAtReturn, "probe_error": errText(adapterErr)},
			"job":          map[string]any{"pid": jobAtReturn.PID, "start_ticks": jobAtReturn.StartTicks, "ppid": jobAtReturn.ParentPID, "state": jobAtReturn.state, "same_identity": sameJobAtReturn, "probe_error": errText(jobErr)},
			"runtime_wait": "unconfirmed while the same original child remains live",
		})
		t.Fatal("built Job returned before the production Runtime Wait completed")
	case <-time.After(100 * time.Millisecond):
	}
	if err != nil || !sameJob || jobAtTerm.state == "Z" {
		t.Fatal("the Job process changed while the Runtime owning Wait was pending")
	}
	if adapterErr != nil || !sameAdapter || adapter.state == "Z" || adapter.ParentPID != job.PID {
		t.Fatal("the Runtime Wait owner did not remain live under the Job while its child was live")
	}
	processEvidence["outcome"] = "Job remained pending while original Runtime Wait was unresolved"
	if err := os.WriteFile(releasePath, []byte("release"), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	select {
	case <-finished:
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("built Job did not return after the Runtime Wait")
	}
	if runErr == nil || !strings.Contains(stdout.String()+stderr.String(), "append AgentRun events") {
		t.Fatalf("built Job error=%v output=%s; want persistent append failure", runErr, stdout.String()+stderr.String())
	}
	if err := assertProcessGone(t, rawChain, job.processIdentity); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	waitFile(pidFile + ".exit")
	processEvidence["outcome"] = "Job returned after fixture release and process-owner cleanup"
	processEvidence["runtime_wait_result"] = "Runtime exit observed before adapter and Job owners returned"
	processEvidence["observations"] = append(processEvidence["observations"].([]map[string]any), map[string]any{
		"phase":                   "after Job return",
		"runtime_identity_absent": true,
		"adapter_identity_absent": true,
		"job_wait_returned":       true,
		"runtime_wait":            "owner completed after fixture release",
	})
}

func errText(err error) string {
	if err == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return err.Error()
}

func TestBuiltEntrypointHoldsOriginalWaitAcrossCleanupDeadlines(t *testing.T) {
	tempDir := t.TempDir()
	waitReturned := filepath.Join(tempDir, "runtime-wait-returned")
	releaseWait := filepath.Join(tempDir, "release-runtime-wait")
	evidencePath := filepath.Join("..", "..", "artifacts", "agentrun-cancellation-prerequisite", "held-wait-process-evidence.jsonl")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(evidencePath), 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(evidencePath, nil, 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	binary, runtimeFixture := buildHeldWaitCommand(t, waitReturned, releaseWait)
	previousRuntime := testRuntimeExecutable
	testRuntimeExecutable = runtimeFixture
	t.Cleanup(func() { testRuntimeExecutable = previousRuntime })

	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name          string
		mode          string
		appendFailure bool
		cancelJob     bool
		timeout       bool
		hold          time.Duration
	}{
		{name: "startup without acceptance", mode: "no-acceptance-delayed-termination", cancelJob: true, hold: 12 * time.Second},
		{name: "malformed stream", mode: "invalid-after-acceptance", hold: 31 * time.Second},
		{name: "persistent append failure", mode: "delayed-termination", appendFailure: true, hold: 31 * time.Second},
		{name: "runtime timeout", mode: "delayed-termination", timeout: true, hold: 31 * time.Second},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			_ = os.Remove(waitReturned)
			_ = os.Remove(releaseWait)
			pidFile := filepath.Join("..", "..", "artifacts", "agentrun-malformed-marker-fixture", "before-control", "runtime.json")
			if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(pidFile), 0o755); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			t.Setenv("AGENTRUN_FIXTURE_MODE", testCase.mode)
			t.Setenv("AGENTRUN_FIXTURE_PID_FILE", pidFile)

			terminalAppends := make(chan struct{}, 1)
			completions := make(chan struct{}, 1)
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
				switch {
				case strings.HasSuffix(request.URL.Path, "/completion"):
					select {
					case completions <- struct{}{}:
					default:
					}
					_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(map[string]bool{"accepted": true})
				case strings.HasSuffix(request.URL.Path, "/events"):
					var body struct {
						Events []struct {
							Sequence uint64 `json:"sequence"`
							Type     string `json:"event_type"`
						} `json:"events"`
					}
					if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
						t.Errorf("decode event append: %v", err)
						writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
						return
					}
					var sequence uint64
					for _, event := range body.Events {
						if event.Sequence > sequence {
							sequence = event.Sequence
						}
						if event.Type == "terminal" {
							select {
							case terminalAppends <- struct{}{}:
							default:
							}
						}
					}
					if testCase.appendFailure {
						writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
						return
					}
					_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(map[string]any{"stream_id": "held-wait-test", "accepted_sequence": sequence})
				default:
					writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusNotFound)
				}
			}))
			defer server.Close()

			launch := validLaunch()
			if testCase.timeout {
				launch.Limits.TimeoutSeconds = 1
			}
			launchPath := writeLaunch(t, launch)
			command := exec.Command(binary)
			command.Env = append(os.Environ(),
				launchFileEnvironment+"="+launchPath,
				platformEndpointEnvironment+"="+server.URL,
				runCredentialEnvironment+"="+writeCredential(t, "fixture-token"),
				mcpInjectionDirectoryEnvironment+"="+t.TempDir(),
			)
			var stdout, stderr lockedBuffer
			command.Stdout, command.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
			if err := command.Start(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			jobSnapshot, err := readProcessSnapshot("/proc", command.Process.Pid)
			if err != nil {
				_ = command.Process.Kill()
				_ = command.Wait()
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			finished := make(chan struct{})
			var runErr error
			go func() {
				runErr = command.Wait()
				close(finished)
			}()
			var rawChain string
			t.Cleanup(func() {
				_ = os.WriteFile(pidFile+".release", []byte("release"), 0o600)
				_ = os.WriteFile(releaseWait, []byte("release"), 0o600)
				select {
				case <-finished:
					return
				default:
				}
				_ = command.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGTERM)
				select {
				case <-finished:
				case <-time.After(12 * time.Second):
					if rawChain != "" {
						if chain, parseErr := parseProcessIdentity(rawChain); parseErr == nil {
							if child, same, observeErr := observeProcess("/proc", chain.Child); observeErr == nil && same {
								if process, findErr := os.FindProcess(child.PID); findErr == nil {
									_ = process.Kill()
								}
							}
						}
					}
					_ = command.Process.Kill()
					<-finished
				}
			})

			waitForFile := func(path string, timeout time.Duration) []byte {
				t.Helper()
				deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
				for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
					contents, readErr := os.ReadFile(path)
					if readErr == nil {
						return contents
					}
					if !os.IsNotExist(readErr) {
						t.Fatal(readErr)
					}
					select {
					case <-finished:
						t.Fatalf("Job returned before %s: error=%v output=%s", filepath.Base(path), runErr, stdout.String()+stderr.String())
					default:
					}
					time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
				}
				t.Fatalf("fixture did not create %s", filepath.Base(path))
				return nil
			}

			var chain processChain
			identityDeadline := time.Now().Add(8 * time.Second)
			for time.Now().Before(identityDeadline) {
				contents, readErr := os.ReadFile(pidFile)
				if readErr == nil {
					rawChain = strings.TrimSpace(string(contents))
					if candidate, parseErr := parseProcessIdentity(rawChain); parseErr == nil {
						chain = candidate
						break
					}
				} else if !os.IsNotExist(readErr) {
					t.Fatal(readErr)
				}
				select {
				case <-finished:
					t.Fatalf("Job returned before writing its process chain: %v", runErr)
				default:
				}
				time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
			}
			if chain.Child.PID == 0 {
				t.Fatal("fixture did not write a complete process chain")
			}
			if chain.Owner != jobSnapshot.processIdentity || chain.Child.ParentPID != chain.Parent.PID || chain.Parent.ParentPID != jobSnapshot.PID {
				t.Fatalf("Runtime chain does not bind to the built Job and linked adapter")
			}
			caseEvidence := map[string]any{"scenario": testCase.name, "process_chain": chain}
			openPipes, err := processPipeDescriptors(jobSnapshot.PID)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			adapterStdout, err := os.Readlink(filepath.Join("/proc", strconv.Itoa(chain.Parent.PID), "fd", "1"))
			if err != nil || !strings.HasPrefix(adapterStdout, "pipe:[") {
				t.Fatalf("adapter stdout is not an owned Job pipe: target=%q err=%v", adapterStdout, err)
			}
			jobOwnsAdapterStdout := false
			for pipe := range openPipes {
				if strings.HasSuffix(pipe, ":"+adapterStdout) {
					jobOwnsAdapterStdout = true
				}
			}
			if !jobOwnsAdapterStdout {
				t.Fatal("Job did not own the adapter stdout pipe before cancellation")
			}
			if testCase.cancelJob {
				if err := command.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGTERM); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			triggerMarker := pidFile + ".term"
			if testCase.mode == "invalid-after-acceptance" {
				triggerMarker = pidFile + ".malformed"
			}
			waitForFile(triggerMarker, 8*time.Second)
			termObservedAt := time.Now()
			if got := string(waitForFile(waitReturned, 12*time.Second)); got != "wait-returned-error" {
				t.Fatalf("held Wait seam result = %q; want a returned process error before its held return", got)
			}
			waitReturnedAt := time.Now()
			if testCase.mode == "invalid-after-acceptance" {
				caseEvidence["runtime_wait_result"] = "returned error after malformed-stream cancellation"
			} else {
				caseEvidence["runtime_wait_result"] = "returned error after five-second TERM grace and SIGKILL escalation"
			}
			caseEvidence["runtime_wait_return_ms_after_cancel_marker"] = waitReturnedAt.Sub(termObservedAt).Milliseconds()
			if testCase.mode != "invalid-after-acceptance" && waitReturnedAt.Sub(termObservedAt) < 4900*time.Millisecond {
				t.Fatalf("Runtime Wait returned after %s; want the unchanged five-second TERM grace", waitReturnedAt.Sub(termObservedAt))
			}
			child, sameChild, err := observeProcess("/proc", chain.Child)
			if err != nil || sameChild {
				t.Fatalf("Runtime identity remained after its actual Wait returned: %#v same=%t err=%v", child, sameChild, err)
			}
			adapter, sameAdapter, err := observeProcess("/proc", chain.Parent)
			if err != nil || !sameAdapter || adapter.state == "Z" || adapter.ParentPID != jobSnapshot.PID {
				t.Fatalf("adapter owning the gated Wait is not live under the built Job: %#v same=%t err=%v", adapter, sameAdapter, err)
			}
			jobAfterWait, sameJob, err := observeProcess("/proc", jobSnapshot.processIdentity)
			if err != nil || !sameJob || jobAfterWait.state == "Z" {
				t.Fatalf("Job returned while its linked adapter Wait was held: %#v same=%t err=%v", jobAfterWait, sameJob, err)
			}
			pipesAfterCancel, err := processPipeDescriptors(jobSnapshot.PID)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			for pipe := range pipesAfterCancel {
				if strings.HasSuffix(pipe, ":"+adapterStdout) {
					t.Fatal("cancellation left the Job-owned adapter stdout pipe open")
				}
			}
			if _, err := os.Readlink(filepath.Join("/proc", strconv.Itoa(chain.Parent.PID), "fd", "1")); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
				t.Fatalf("adapter retained its owned stdout endpoint after cancellation: %v", err)
			}
			caseEvidence["adapter_and_job_alive_after_wait_result"] = true
			caseEvidence["job_owned_adapter_stdout_closed"] = true

			lastOwnerCheck := time.Time{}
			const diagnosticText = "cleanup remains pending; adapter owning Wait has not returned"
			assertStillPending := func() {
				t.Helper()
				select {
				case <-finished:
					t.Fatalf("Job returned before held Wait release: %v", runErr)
				default:
				}
				select {
				case <-terminalAppends:
					t.Fatal("SDK terminal was published before held Wait release")
				default:
				}
				select {
				case <-completions:
					t.Fatal("CompleteAgentRun ran before held Wait release")
				default:
				}
				if time.Since(lastOwnerCheck) >= time.Second {
					adapter, sameAdapter, err := observeProcess("/proc", chain.Parent)
					if err != nil || !sameAdapter || adapter.state == "Z" || adapter.ParentPID != jobSnapshot.PID {
						t.Fatalf("adapter owning the held Wait stopped during the deadline window: %#v same=%t err=%v", adapter, sameAdapter, err)
					}
					job, sameJob, err := observeProcess("/proc", jobSnapshot.processIdentity)
					if err != nil || !sameJob || job.state == "Z" {
						t.Fatalf("Job stopped during the held Wait deadline window: %#v same=%t err=%v", job, sameJob, err)
					}
					lastOwnerCheck = time.Now()
				}
			}
			waitUntil := func(deadline time.Time) {
				t.Helper()
				for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
					assertStillPending()
					time.Sleep(min(100*time.Millisecond, time.Until(deadline)))
				}
				assertStillPending()
			}
			diagnosticDeadline := termObservedAt.Add(12 * time.Second)
			diagnosticEarliest := termObservedAt.Add(9 * time.Second)
			diagnosticSeen := false
			var diagnosticSeenAt time.Time
			for time.Now().Before(diagnosticDeadline) {
				assertStillPending()
				if strings.Contains(stderr.String(), diagnosticText) {
					diagnosticSeen = true
					diagnosticSeenAt = time.Now()
					break
				}
				time.Sleep(25 * time.Millisecond)
			}
			if !diagnosticSeen || diagnosticSeenAt.Before(diagnosticEarliest) {
				t.Fatalf("pending cleanup diagnostic did not appear at the unchanged ten-second observation window")
			}
			waitUntil(termObservedAt.Add(11 * time.Second))

			diagnostic := stderr.String()
			if strings.Count(diagnostic, diagnosticText) != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("pending cleanup diagnostic count=%d output=%q", strings.Count(diagnostic, diagnosticText), diagnostic)
			}
			for _, private := range []string{strconv.Itoa(chain.Child.PID), strconv.Itoa(chain.Parent.PID), strconv.Itoa(jobSnapshot.PID), pidFile, "fixture-token"} {
				if strings.Contains(diagnostic, private) {
					t.Fatalf("pending cleanup diagnostic disclosed process or credential data")
				}
			}
			for _, line := range strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(diagnostic), "\n") {
				if strings.Contains(line, diagnosticText) && len(line) > 256 {
					t.Fatalf("pending cleanup diagnostic exceeded its bound: %d bytes", len(line))
				}
			}
			waitUntil(termObservedAt.Add(testCase.hold))
			caseEvidence["held_ms_after_cancel_marker"] = time.Since(termObservedAt).Milliseconds()
			caseEvidence["pending_diagnostic_count"] = 1
			caseEvidence["no_job_return_terminal_or_complete_before_release"] = true
			caseEvidence["deadlines_checked_seconds"] = []int{10}
			if testCase.hold >= 31*time.Second {
				caseEvidence["deadlines_checked_seconds"] = []int{10, 20, 30}
			}

			if err := os.WriteFile(releaseWait, []byte("release"), 0o600); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			select {
			case <-finished:
			case <-time.After(8 * time.Second):
				t.Fatal("Job did not settle after the held owning Wait was released")
			}
			if testCase.appendFailure && (runErr == nil || !strings.Contains(stdout.String()+stderr.String(), "append AgentRun events")) {
				t.Fatalf("Job error=%v output=%s; want the persistent append failure", runErr, stdout.String()+stderr.String())
			}
			if err := assertProcessGone(t, rawChain, jobSnapshot.processIdentity); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			caseEvidence["process_chain_reaped_after_release"] = true
			encodedEvidence, err := json.Marshal(caseEvidence)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			file, err := os.OpenFile(evidencePath, os.O_APPEND|os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if _, err := file.Write(append(encodedEvidence, '\n')); err != nil {
				_ = file.Close()
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if testCase.appendFailure || testCase.cancelJob {
				select {
				case <-completions:
					t.Fatal("CompleteAgentRun ran for a failed or unaccepted session")
				default:
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func buildHeldWaitCommand(t *testing.T, waitReturned, releaseWait string) (string, string) {
	t.Helper()
	root := filepath.Clean(filepath.Join("..", ".."))
	directory := t.TempDir()
	vendorSource := filepath.Join(root, "cmd/agentrun-job/vendor/main.go")
	contents, err := os.ReadFile(vendorSource)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	originalWait := "waitErr = process.Wait()"
	call := fmt.Sprintf("waitErr = holdRuntimeWaitForTest(process, %q, %q)", waitReturned, releaseWait)
	if !strings.Contains(string(contents), originalWait) {
		originalWait = "err := process.Wait()"
		call = fmt.Sprintf("err := holdRuntimeWaitForTest(process, %q, %q)", waitReturned, releaseWait)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(string(contents), originalWait) {
		t.Fatal("could not locate the Runtime's original owning Wait")
	}
	contents = bytes.Replace(contents, []byte(originalWait), []byte(call), 1)
	contents = append(contents, []byte(fmt.Sprintf(`

func holdRuntimeWaitForTest(process *exec.Cmd, enteredPath, releasePath string) error {
	waitErr := process.Wait()
	result := "wait-returned-ok"
	if waitErr != nil { result = "wait-returned-error" }
	if err := os.WriteFile(enteredPath, []byte(result), 0600); err != nil { return err }
	for {
		if _, err := os.Stat(releasePath); err == nil { return waitErr } else if !os.IsNotExist(err) { return err }
		time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}
`))...)
	testVendorSource := filepath.Join(directory, "vendor-main-test.go")
	if err := os.WriteFile(testVendorSource, contents, 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	vendorOverlay := filepath.Join(directory, "vendor-overlay.json")
	writeGoOverlay(t, vendorOverlay, vendorSource, testVendorSource)
	vendorBinary := filepath.Join(directory, "agentrun-vendor")
	buildVendor := exec.Command("go", "test", "-c", "-trimpath", "-buildvcs=false", "-ldflags=-s -w -buildid=", "-overlay="+vendorOverlay, "-o", vendorBinary, "./cmd/agentrun-job/vendor")
	buildVendor.Dir = root
	buildVendor.Env = append(os.Environ(), "CGO_ENABLED=0")
	if output, err := buildVendor.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("build test-only held-Wait adapter error=%v\n%s", err, output)
	}

	identityPath := filepath.Join(root, "cmd/agentrun-job/driver_identity.json")
	identityJSON, err := os.ReadFile(identityPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var identity driverIdentity
	if err := json.Unmarshal(identityJSON, &identity); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	vendorBytes, err := os.ReadFile(vendorBinary)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(vendorBytes)
	identity.Vendor.ArtifactDigest = fmt.Sprintf("sha256:%x", digest)
	identity.Vendor.Args = []string{"--oac-held-wait-test"}
	testIdentity := filepath.Join(directory, "driver_identity.json")
	identityJSON, err = json.MarshalIndent(identity, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(testIdentity, identityJSON, 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	jobOverlay := filepath.Join(directory, "job-overlay.json")
	writeGoOverlay(t, jobOverlay, identityPath, testIdentity)
	jobBinary := filepath.Join(directory, "agentrun-job")
	buildJob := exec.Command("go", "build", "-trimpath", "-buildvcs=false", "-ldflags=-s -w -buildid=", "-overlay="+jobOverlay, "-o", jobBinary, "./cmd/agentrun-job")
	buildJob.Dir = root
	buildJob.Env = append(os.Environ(), "CGO_ENABLED=0")
	if output, err := buildJob.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("build held-Wait Job error=%v\n%s", err, output)
	}

	runtimeFixture := filepath.Join(directory, "runtime-fixture")
	buildFixture := exec.Command("go", "build", "-trimpath", "-buildvcs=false", "-ldflags=-s -w -buildid=", "-o", runtimeFixture, "./cmd/agentrun-job/testdata/vendor")
	buildFixture.Dir = root
	buildFixture.Env = append(os.Environ(), "CGO_ENABLED=0")
	if output, err := buildFixture.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("build configured Runtime fixture error=%v\n%s", err, output)
	}
	return jobBinary, runtimeFixture
}

func writeGoOverlay(t *testing.T, overlayPath, originalPath, replacementPath string) {
	t.Helper()
	originalPath, err := filepath.Abs(originalPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	replacementPath, err = filepath.Abs(replacementPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	contents, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"Replace": map[string]string{originalPath: replacementPath}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(overlayPath, contents, 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func processPipeDescriptors(pid int) (map[string]struct{}, error) {
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join("/proc", strconv.Itoa(pid), "fd"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	pipes := make(map[string]struct{})
	for _, entry := range entries {
		target, err := os.Readlink(filepath.Join("/proc", strconv.Itoa(pid), "fd", entry.Name()))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(target, "pipe:[") {
			pipes[entry.Name()+":"+target] = struct{}{}
		}
	}
	return pipes, nil
}

type lockedBuffer struct {
	mu sync.Mutex
	bytes.Buffer
}

func (buffer *lockedBuffer) Write(contents []byte) (int, error) {
	buffer.mu.Lock()
	defer buffer.mu.Unlock()
	return buffer.Buffer.Write(contents)
}

func (buffer *lockedBuffer) String() string {
	buffer.mu.Lock()
	defer buffer.mu.Unlock()
	return buffer.Buffer.String()
}

func TestRunWaitsForDriverWaitAfterPersistentAppendFailure(t *testing.T) {
	runCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	vendor := newWaitGateVendor()
	client := &waitGateClient{appendCalls: make(chan []runtimesdk.RuntimeEvent, 4), completeCalls: make(chan struct{}, 1)}
	config := testConfig()
	config.MaxBatchEvents = 1
	config.MaxBufferedEvents = 1
	config.Retry.MaxAttempts = 1
	launchPath := writeLaunch(t, validLaunch())
	dependencies := Dependencies{
		DriverFactory:   waitGateDriverFactory{vendor: vendor},
		ClientFactory:   testClientFactory{client: client},
		MCPMaterializer: testMaterializer{},
		Config:          config,
	}
	runResult := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		runResult <- run(runCtx, func(string) string { return launchPath }, func() (Dependencies, error) { return dependencies, nil })
	}()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		cancel()
		vendor.releaseWait()
		select {
		case <-vendor.waitDone:
		case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
			t.Error("test vendor child was not waited during cleanup")
		}
	})

	select {
	case <-vendor.started:
	case err := <-runResult:
		t.Fatalf("Job run ended before starting its vendor: %v", err)
	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("vendor child did not start")
	}
	chain := vendor.chain
	owner, err := currentProcessIdentity()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if chain.Owner != owner || chain.Child.ParentPID != chain.Parent.PID || chain.Parent.ParentPID != owner.PID {
		t.Fatalf("vendor process chain = %#v; owner = %#v", chain, owner)
	}
	select {
	case batch := <-client.appendCalls:
		if len(batch) != 1 || batch[0].Type != runtimesdk.StartedEvent {
			t.Fatalf("first append batch = %#v; want started", batch)
		}
	case err := <-runResult:
		t.Fatalf("Job run ended before persistent append failure: %v", err)
	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("AgentRun Job did not attempt the first event append")
	}
	assertChildLive := func() {
		child, sameChild, err := observeProcess("/proc", chain.Child)
		if err != nil || !sameChild || child.state == "Z" || child.ParentPID != chain.Parent.PID {
			t.Fatal("the delayed vendor child is not the same live process under its recorded parent")
		}
		parent, sameParent, err := observeProcess("/proc", chain.Parent)
		if err != nil || !sameParent || parent.ParentPID != owner.PID {
			t.Fatal("the delayed vendor parent is not the same process under the recorded Job owner")
		}
	}
	select {
	case <-vendor.cancelSeen:
	case err := <-runResult:
		select {
		case <-vendor.cancelSeen:
		case <-time.After(time.Second):
			t.Fatal("Job returned before its driver observed cancellation")
		}
		assertChildLive()
		t.Fatalf("Job run returned while the vendor child was live and before its owner's Wait: %v", err)
	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("persistent append failure did not cancel the vendor context")
	}
	assertChildLive()

	postCancelEvent := runtimesdk.RuntimeEventDraft{Type: runtimesdk.MessageEvent, Payload: &runtimesdk.MessagePayload{MessageID: "after-cancel", Content: "discarded"}}
	select {
	case vendor.events <- postCancelEvent:
	case err := <-runResult:
		assertChildLive()
		t.Fatalf("Job returned while its child was live and unreaped: %v", err)
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		t.Fatal("Runtime SDK stopped draining the driver after cancellation")
	}
	select {
	case err := <-runResult:
		assertChildLive()
		t.Fatalf("Job returned before the driver's owning Wait: %v", err)
	case <-time.After(vendorExitWait + 100*time.Millisecond):
	}
	assertChildLive()
	select {
	case <-client.completeCalls:
		t.Fatal("CompleteAgentRun ran while the driver's owning Wait was pending")
	default:
	}

	vendor.releaseWait()
	select {
	case <-vendor.waitDone:
	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("driver did not complete its owning Wait")
	}
	select {
	case err := <-runResult:
		if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "append AgentRun events") {
			t.Fatalf("Job run error = %v; want the persistent append failure", err)
		}
	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("Job did not return after driver Wait completed")
	}
	select {
	case <-client.completeCalls:
		t.Fatal("CompleteAgentRun ran after persistent append failure")
	default:
	}
	rawIdentity, err := json.Marshal(chain)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := assertProcessGone(t, string(rawIdentity), owner); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

// TestBuiltEntrypointRejectsTerminalSessionMismatch proves that a terminal
// protocol message carrying a different native vendor session id is rejected
// and reported as a failed completion rather than rewritten to the accepted
// session.
func TestBuiltEntrypointRejectsTerminalSessionMismatch(t *testing.T) {
	binary := buildCommand(t)
	t.Setenv("AGENTRUN_FIXTURE_MODE", "terminal-wrong-session")
	server := newFixturePlatformServer(t)
	injectionDirectory := t.TempDir()
	credentialPath := writeCredential(t, "fixture-token")
	launchPath := writeLaunch(t, validLaunch())

	command := exec.Command(binary)
	command.Env = append(os.Environ(),
		launchFileEnvironment+"="+launchPath,
		platformEndpointEnvironment+"="+server.URL(),
		runCredentialEnvironment+"="+credentialPath,
		mcpInjectionDirectoryEnvironment+"="+injectionDirectory,
	)
	if output, err := command.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("built command error = %v\n%s", err, output)
	}
	if !server.completed {
		t.Fatal("Platform Core fixture did not receive the completion")
	}
	if server.completionResult["outcome"] != "failed" {
		t.Fatalf("completion result = %#v; want failed", server.completionResult)
	}
	if server.completionResult["error_type"] != "terminal-session-mismatch" {
		t.Fatalf("completion result = %#v; want terminal-session-mismatch", server.completionResult)
	}
}

// TestBuiltEntrypointEnforcesRuntimeTimeout proves that the fixed Runtime
// timeout is enforced as a cancellation deadline: a non-terminating vendor is
// cancelled at the deadline, reaped, and the Job reports a truthful cancelled
// completion (never a false success).
func TestBuiltEntrypointEnforcesRuntimeTimeout(t *testing.T) {
	binary := buildCommand(t)
	t.Setenv("AGENTRUN_FIXTURE_MODE", "slow")
	server := newFixturePlatformServer(t)
	injectionDirectory := t.TempDir()
	pidFile := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "vendor.pid")
	t.Setenv("AGENTRUN_FIXTURE_PID_FILE", pidFile)
	credentialPath := writeCredential(t, "fixture-token")

	launch := validLaunch()
	launch.Limits.TimeoutSeconds = 1
	launchPath := writeLaunch(t, launch)

	command := exec.Command(binary)
	command.Env = append(os.Environ(),
		launchFileEnvironment+"="+launchPath,
		platformEndpointEnvironment+"="+server.URL(),
		runCredentialEnvironment+"="+credentialPath,
		mcpInjectionDirectoryEnvironment+"="+injectionDirectory,
		"AGENTRUN_FIXTURE_PID_FILE="+pidFile,
	)
	output, err, jobIdentity, identityErr := runCommandWithIdentity(command)
	if identityErr != nil {
		t.Fatal(identityErr)
	}
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("built command error = %v\n%s", err, output)
	}
	if !server.completed {
		t.Fatal("Platform Core fixture did not receive the completion")
	}
	if server.completionResult["outcome"] != "cancelled" {
		t.Fatalf("completion result = %#v; want cancelled", server.completionResult)
	}
	pid, err := os.ReadFile(pidFile)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read vendor process identity: %v", err)
	}
	if err := assertProcessGone(t, strings.TrimSpace(string(pid)), jobIdentity); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

// TestBuiltEntrypointNoFalseSuccessOnTerminalThenHang proves that a vendor
// which emits a successful terminal but keeps running cannot yield a false
// success completion: the child is killed and reaped, and the completion is
// reported as failed (vendor-not-exited) with no live child remaining.
func TestBuiltEntrypointNoFalseSuccessOnTerminalThenHang(t *testing.T) {
	binary := buildCommand(t)
	t.Setenv("AGENTRUN_FIXTURE_MODE", "terminal-then-hang")
	server := newFixturePlatformServer(t)
	injectionDirectory := t.TempDir()
	pidFile := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "vendor.pid")
	t.Setenv("AGENTRUN_FIXTURE_PID_FILE", pidFile)
	credentialPath := writeCredential(t, "fixture-token")
	launchPath := writeLaunch(t, validLaunch())

	command := exec.Command(binary)
	command.Env = append(os.Environ(),
		launchFileEnvironment+"="+launchPath,
		platformEndpointEnvironment+"="+server.URL(),
		runCredentialEnvironment+"="+credentialPath,
		mcpInjectionDirectoryEnvironment+"="+injectionDirectory,
		"AGENTRUN_FIXTURE_PID_FILE="+pidFile,
	)
	output, err, jobIdentity, identityErr := runCommandWithIdentity(command)
	if identityErr != nil {
		t.Fatal(identityErr)
	}
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("built command error = %v\n%s", err, output)
	}
	if !server.completed {
		t.Fatal("Platform Core fixture did not receive the completion")
	}
	if server.completionResult["outcome"] != "failed" {
		t.Fatalf("completion result = %#v; want failed", server.completionResult)
	}
	if server.completionResult["error_type"] != "vendor-no-eof" {
		t.Fatalf("completion result = %#v; want vendor-no-eof", server.completionResult)
	}
	pid, err := os.ReadFile(pidFile)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read vendor process identity: %v", err)
	}
	if err := assertProcessGone(t, strings.TrimSpace(string(pid)), jobIdentity); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestBuiltEntrypointReturnsNonZeroForInvalidLaunch(t *testing.T) {
	binary := buildCommand(t)
	server := newFixturePlatformServer(t)
	launchPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "invalid-launch.json")
	if err := os.WriteFile(launchPath, []byte("not json"), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	command := exec.Command(binary)
	command.Env = append(os.Environ(),
		launchFileEnvironment+"="+launchPath,
		platformEndpointEnvironment+"="+server.URL(),
		runCredentialEnvironment+"="+writeCredential(t, "fixture-token"),
		mcpInjectionDirectoryEnvironment+"="+t.TempDir(),
	)
	if output, err := command.CombinedOutput(); err == nil || !strings.Contains(string(output), "decode mounted launch input") {
		t.Fatalf("built command error=%v output=%s", err, output)
	}
}

func TestBuiltEntrypointFailsClosedWithoutHostEnvironment(t *testing.T) {
	binary := buildCommand(t)
	launchPath := writeLaunch(t, validLaunch())
	command := exec.Command(binary)
	command.Env = append(os.Environ(), launchFileEnvironment+"="+launchPath)
	if output, err := command.CombinedOutput(); err == nil || !strings.Contains(string(output), platformEndpointEnvironment) {
		t.Fatalf("built command error=%v output=%s", err, output)
	}
}

func buildCommand(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	root := filepath.Clean(filepath.Join("..", ".."))
	binary := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "agentrun-job")
	command := exec.Command("go", "build", "-trimpath", "-buildvcs=false", "-ldflags=-s -w -buildid=", "-o", binary, "./cmd/agentrun-job")
	command.Dir = root
	if output, err := command.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("build command error = %v\n%s", err, output)
	}
	installVendorBeside(t, binary)
	return binary
}

func runCommandWithIdentity(command *exec.Cmd) (string, error, processIdentity, error) {
	var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
	command.Stdout = &stdout
	command.Stderr = &stderr
	if err := command.Start(); err != nil {
		return "", err, processIdentity{}, nil
	}
	snapshot, err := readProcessSnapshot("/proc", command.Process.Pid)
	if err != nil {
		_ = command.Process.Kill()
		_ = command.Wait()
		return stdout.String() + stderr.String(), nil, processIdentity{}, err
	}
	runErr := command.Wait()
	return stdout.String() + stderr.String(), runErr, snapshot.processIdentity, nil
}

func writeLaunch(t *testing.T, launch contractsagentrun.LaunchFact) string {
	t.Helper()
	contents, err := json.Marshal(launch)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "launch.json")
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, contents, 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return path
}

func validLaunch() contractsagentrun.LaunchFact {
	return contractsagentrun.LaunchFact{
		AgentRunID: "run-1", LaunchDigest: "launch-digest", AgentDefinitionID: "agent-1", RuntimeBindingID: "binding-1",
		Invocation:       contractsagentrun.InvocationRequest{InvocationID: "invocation-1", RequestDigest: "request-digest", Objective: "run tests", Contract: contractsagentrun.WorkContract{ContractID: "work-contract", ContractDigest: "work-digest", OutputSlots: []contractsagentrun.ContractSlot{{Key: "result", MediaType: "application/json"}}, CompletionRequirements: []string{"submit"}, ResultSchemaDigest: "result-schema"}, SubmissionContract: contractsagentrun.SubmissionContract{ContractID: "submission-contract", ContractDigest: "submission-digest", RequiredConclusion: true, OutputSlots: []contractsagentrun.ContractSlot{{Key: "result", MediaType: "application/json"}}, ResultSchemaDigest: "submission-schema", Channel: contractsagentrun.AgentWorkChannel}},
		Lineage:          contractsagentrun.Lineage{LineageID: "lineage-1", WorkUnitID: "work-unit-1", ResponsibilityKey: "developer", Iteration: 1},
		Session:          contractsagentrun.SessionReference{Mode: contractsagentrun.NewSession},
		Instructions:     contractsagentrun.LaunchInstructionSet{AgentInstructions: contractsagentrun.InstructionLayer{Language: "en", Content: "agent", Digest: "agent-digest"}, CollaborationBootstrap: contractsagentrun.InstructionLayer{Language: "en", Content: "bootstrap", Digest: "bootstrap-digest"}, InstructionSetDigest: "instructions-digest"},
		Model:            contractsagentrun.ResolvedModel{APIType: contractsagentrun.OpenAIResponsesAPI, Name: "model-1", ConfigurationDigest: "model-digest", Configuration: []contractsagentrun.NonSensitiveSetting{{Key: "base_uri", Value: "https://models.example.test"}}},
		Workspace:        contractsagentrun.WorkspaceLaunch{RootPath: "/workspace", BaselineDigest: "workspace-digest"},
		DriverParameters: mapRuntimeDriverParameters(),
		Limits:           contractsagentrun.RuntimeLimits{TimeoutSeconds: 30, MaxTurns: 3},
		RuntimeAdapter:   linkedDriverAdapter(),
	}
}

func mapRuntimeDriverParameters() []contractsagentrun.DriverParameter {
	parameters := runtimeDriverParameters()
	mapped := make([]contractsagentrun.DriverParameter, len(parameters))
	for index, parameter := range parameters {
		mapped[index] = contractsagentrun.DriverParameter{Name: parameter.Name, Value: parameter.Value}
	}
	return mapped
}

func testConfig() job.Config {
	return job.Config{MaxBatchEvents: 2, MaxBufferedEvents: 2, FlushAfter: time.Second, Retry: job.RetryPolicy{MaxAttempts: 2}}
}

type waitGateDriverFactory struct{ vendor *waitGateVendor }

func (factory waitGateDriverFactory) RuntimeDriver(context.Context, runtimeadapter.ResolvedRuntimeAdapter) (runtimesdk.RuntimeDriver, error) {
	return runtimesdk.NewCore(factory.vendor, nil), nil
}

type waitGateVendor struct {
	started    chan struct{}
	cancelSeen chan struct{}
	allowWait  chan struct{}
	waitDone   chan struct{}
	events     chan runtimesdk.RuntimeEventDraft
	chain      processChain
	release    sync.Once
}

func newWaitGateVendor() *waitGateVendor {
	return &waitGateVendor{
		started:    make(chan struct{}),
		cancelSeen: make(chan struct{}),
		allowWait:  make(chan struct{}),
		waitDone:   make(chan struct{}),
	}
}

func (vendor *waitGateVendor) ValidateParameters([]runtimesdk.DriverParameter) error { return nil }

func (vendor *waitGateVendor) Start(ctx context.Context, request runtimesdk.RuntimeRequest) (*runtimesdk.VendorSession, error) {
	command := exec.Command("sh", "-c", `sleep 60 & child=$!; printf '%s\n' "$child"; wait "$child"`)
	command.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid: true}
	stdout, err := command.StdoutPipe()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := command.Start(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	cleanupStartFailure := func(err error) (*runtimesdk.VendorSession, error) {
		_ = syscall.Kill(-command.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
		_ = command.Wait()
		return nil, err
	}
	childLine, err := bufio.NewReader(stdout).ReadString('\n')
	if err != nil {
		return cleanupStartFailure(err)
	}
	childPID, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(childLine))
	if err != nil {
		return cleanupStartFailure(err)
	}
	child, err := readProcessSnapshot("/proc", childPID)
	if err != nil {
		return cleanupStartFailure(err)
	}
	parent, err := readProcessSnapshot("/proc", command.Process.Pid)
	if err != nil {
		return cleanupStartFailure(err)
	}
	owner, err := currentProcessIdentity()
	if err != nil {
		return cleanupStartFailure(err)
	}
	vendor.chain = processChain{Child: child.processIdentity, Parent: parent.processIdentity, Owner: owner}
	vendor.events = make(chan runtimesdk.RuntimeEventDraft)
	close(vendor.started)
	results := make(chan runtimesdk.RuntimeResult, 1)
	go func() {
		<-ctx.Done()
		close(vendor.cancelSeen)
		<-vendor.allowWait
		_ = syscall.Kill(childPID, syscall.SIGTERM)
		_ = command.Wait()
		close(vendor.waitDone)
		close(vendor.events)
		results <- runtimesdk.RuntimeResult{Outcome: runtimesdk.CancelledOutcome, VendorSessionID: "vendor-1"}
		close(results)
	}()
	return &runtimesdk.VendorSession{
		Acceptance: runtimesdk.DriverAcceptance{
			Outcome:         runtimesdk.CreatedSession,
			VendorSessionID: "vendor-1",
			Instructions: runtimesdk.InstructionAcceptance{
				AgentInstructionsDigest:      request.Instructions.AgentInstructions.Digest,
				CollaborationBootstrapDigest: request.Instructions.CollaborationBootstrap.Digest,
				InstructionSetDigest:         request.Instructions.InstructionSetDigest,
			},
		},
		Events: vendor.events,
		Result: results,
	}, nil
}

func (vendor *waitGateVendor) releaseWait() {
	vendor.release.Do(func() { close(vendor.allowWait) })
}

type waitGateClient struct {
	appendCalls   chan []runtimesdk.RuntimeEvent
	completeCalls chan struct{}
}

func (client *waitGateClient) AppendAgentRunEvents(_ context.Context, events []runtimesdk.RuntimeEvent) (job.EventAcknowledgement, error) {
	client.appendCalls <- append([]runtimesdk.RuntimeEvent(nil), events...)
	return job.EventAcknowledgement{}, errors.New("persistent append failure")
}

func (client *waitGateClient) CompleteAgentRun(context.Context, runtimesdk.RuntimeResult) error {
	select {
	case client.completeCalls <- struct{}{}:
	default:
	}
	return nil
}

type testDriverFactory struct{}

func (testDriverFactory) RuntimeDriver(context.Context, runtimeadapter.ResolvedRuntimeAdapter) (runtimesdk.RuntimeDriver, error) {
	return runtimesdk.NewCore(testVendor{}, func() string { return "stream-1" }), nil
}

type testVendor struct{}

func (testVendor) ValidateParameters([]runtimesdk.DriverParameter) error { return nil }

func (testVendor) Start(_ context.Context, request runtimesdk.RuntimeRequest) (*runtimesdk.VendorSession, error) {
	events := make(chan runtimesdk.RuntimeEventDraft, 1)
	events <- runtimesdk.RuntimeEventDraft{DraftID: "message-1", Type: runtimesdk.MessageEvent, Payload: &runtimesdk.MessagePayload{MessageID: "message-1", Content: "hello"}}
	close(events)
	result := make(chan runtimesdk.RuntimeResult, 1)
	result <- runtimesdk.RuntimeResult{Outcome: runtimesdk.SucceededOutcome, VendorSessionID: "vendor-1"}
	close(result)
	return &runtimesdk.VendorSession{Acceptance: runtimesdk.DriverAcceptance{Outcome: runtimesdk.CreatedSession, VendorSessionID: "vendor-1", Instructions: runtimesdk.InstructionAcceptance{AgentInstructionsDigest: request.Instructions.AgentInstructions.Digest, CollaborationBootstrapDigest: request.Instructions.CollaborationBootstrap.Digest, InstructionSetDigest: request.Instructions.InstructionSetDigest}}, Events: events, Result: result}, nil
}

	return factory.client, nil

	return "/run/oac/mcp-credentials.json", nil

type testClient struct {
	appendAttempts int
	completed      bool
}

func (client *testClient) AppendAgentRunEvents(_ context.Context, events []runtimesdk.RuntimeEvent) (job.EventAcknowledgement, error) {
	client.appendAttempts++
	return job.EventAcknowledgement{StreamID: events[len(events)-1].StreamID, AcceptedSequence: events[len(events)-1].Sequence}, nil
}

func (client *testClient) CompleteAgentRun(context.Context, runtimesdk.RuntimeResult) error {
	client.completed = true
	return nil
}
